title: Concept: Weak response control (wildcard Timing-Allow-Origin)
description: Timing-Allow-Origin is set to the wildcard. Resource Timing then reports detailed per-resource timing to any origin that embeds or fetches the resource, giving that origin a measurement channel that survives the same-origin policy and can be used to infer cache state, response size and activity.
risk: Cross-origin measurement of cache state, payload size and activity; MEDIUM severity because the leak is metadata rather than content.
